measurementMethod: Spawned the already-built stdio server with BACKEND_URL pointed to an ephemeral 127.0.0.1 synthetic HTTP fixture; no Chrome, user backend, configuration, or credential store was contacted.

tools.name: tabz_docs

tools.name: tabz_get_page_info
tools.description:

tabId.description: Specific tab ID to get info for. If not specified, returns info for the active tab.

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for structured data

tools.name: tabz_click
tools.description:
Click an element on the page. Waits up to 5 seconds for element to appear.

selector.description: CSS selector for the element to click (e.g., 'button.submit', '#login-btn', 'a[href="/home"]')

tools.name: tabz_fill

tools.description:

tabId.description: Target a specific tab by Chrome tab ID (from tabz_list_tabs). If not provided, uses the current tab.

selector.description: CSS selector for the element to inspect (e.g., '.card', '#header', 'button.primary')

styleProperties.description: Specific CSS properties to extract. If not provided, extracts common layout/typography/visual properties.

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for structured data

tools.description: Open a URL in the browser. Auto-adds protocol (http for localhost, https otherwise). Reuses existing tab by default. URL whitelist configurable in Dashboard settings. Use tabz_docs for detailed docs.

tools.name: tabz_get_console_logs
tools.description:
Get browser console logs (errors, warnings, info, debug). Captured from all open tabs.

Args: level (optional: all/log/info/warn/error/debug), limit (optional), since (optional), tabId (optional)

limit.description: Maximum number of log entries to return (1-1000, default: 100)

since.description: Only return logs after this timestamp (milliseconds since epoch)

tabId.description: Filter logs by specific browser tab ID

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for structured data

tools.name: tabz_execute_script

code.description: JavaScript code to execute in the browser. The result of the last expression is returned.

tabId.description: Target tab ID. If not specified, executes in the active tab.

allFrames.description: Execute in all frames of the page (default: false, main frame only)

tools.name: tabz_enable_network_capture

urlPattern.description: Filter by URL pattern (regex or substring). E.g., 'api/', '\.json$', 'graphql'

statusMin.description: Minimum status code (e.g., 400 for errors only)

statusMax.description: Maximum status code (e.g., 299 for successful only)

limit.description: Maximum number of requests to return (1-200, default: 50)

offset.description: Number of requests to skip for pagination

tabId.description: Filter by specific browser tab ID

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for structured data

tools.name: tabz_clear_network_requests
tools.description: Clear all captured network requests. Capture remains active after clearing.

tools.name: tabz_download_file
tools.description:
Download a file via Chrome's download manager. Returns both Windows and WSL paths.

Args: url (required), filename (optional), conflictAction (optional: uniquify/overwrite/prompt)

url.description: URL of the file to download. Must be a valid URL.

conflictAction.description: Action when file exists: 'uniquify' adds suffix (default), 'overwrite' replaces, 'prompt' asks user

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for structured data

tools.name: tabz_get_downloads
tools.description:
List recent Chrome downloads with status, size, and file paths.

Args: limit (optional, default 20), state (optional: in_progress/complete/interrupted/all)

limit.description: Maximum number of downloads to return (1-100, default: 20)

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for structured data

tools.name: tabz_cancel_download
tools.description:
Cancel an in-progress download. Get IDs from tabz_get_downloads.

Args: downloadId (required)

downloadId.description: The download ID to cancel (from tabz_get_downloads)

tools.name: tabz_save_page
tools.description:
Save current tab as MHTML file (complete page archive with CSS/images/JS). Returns both Windows and WSL paths.

Args: tabId (optional), filename (optional, no extension), response_format (optional)

tabId.description: Tab ID to save. If not specified, saves the currently active tab.

filename.description: Custom filename (without extension). Defaults to page title + timestamp. Extension will be .mhtml.

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' (default) or 'json'

tools.name: tabz_get_bookmark_tree
tools.description: Browse Chrome bookmarks hierarchy. Folder IDs: "1"=Bookmarks Bar, "2"=Other Bookmarks. Use tabz_docs for detailed docs.

folderId.description: Folder ID to get children of. Omit for full tree. Special IDs: '1' = Bookmarks Bar, '2' = Other Bookmarks

maxDepth.description: Maximum depth to traverse (1-10, default: 3). Use 1 for immediate children only.

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for structured data

tools.name: tabz_search_bookmarks
tools.description: Search bookmarks by title or URL. Returns matching bookmarks with IDs for use with move/delete tools. Use tabz_docs for detailed docs.

query.description: Search query - matches against bookmark titles and URLs

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for structured data

tools.name: tabz_save_bookmark
tools.description: Save a URL as a Chrome bookmark. Defaults to Bookmarks Bar ("1"). Use parentId for other folders. Use tabz_docs for detailed docs.

parentId.description: Parent folder ID. Default: '1' (Bookmarks Bar). Use '2' for Other Bookmarks, or a folder ID from tabz_get_bookmark_tree.

tools.description: Create a bookmark folder. Defaults to Bookmarks Bar ("1"). Returns folder ID for use with tabz_save_bookmark. Use tabz_docs for detailed docs.

parentId.description: Parent folder ID. Default: '1' (Bookmarks Bar). Use '2' for Other Bookmarks.

index.description: Position within parent (0 = first). Omit to add at end.

tools.name: tabz_move_bookmark
tools.description: Move a bookmark or folder to a different location. Requires id and destination parentId. Use tabz_docs for detailed docs.

id.description: Bookmark or folder ID to move (from tabz_get_bookmark_tree or tabz_search_bookmarks)

parentId.description: Destination folder ID. Use '1' for Bookmarks Bar, '2' for Other Bookmarks.

tools.name: tabz_delete_bookmark
tools.description: Delete a bookmark or folder permanently. WARNING: deleting a folder removes all contents. Use tabz_docs for detailed docs.

id.description: Bookmark or folder ID to delete. WARNING: Deleting a folder removes all contents!

tools.name: tabz_get_dom_tree

selector.description: CSS selector to get a specific subtree. Omit to get the full document.

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable tree or 'json' for structured data

tools.name: tabz_profile_performance

tabId.description: Chrome tab ID. Omit to use the currently active tab.

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for categorized metrics or 'json' for raw data

tabId.description: Chrome tab ID. Omit to use the currently active tab.

type.description: Coverage type: 'js' for JavaScript only, 'css' for CSS only, 'both' for both

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for summary with file list or 'json' for detailed data

tools.name: tabz_create_window

Create a new Chrome window. Use type="popup" for minimal UI. Use url="/sidepanel/sidepanel.html" for terminal popout.

priority.description: Audio priority. 'high' interrupts current audio (use for important announcements). 'low' is skipped if high-priority audio is playing (use for status updates).

tools.name: tabz_notification_clear
tools.description:
Dismiss a notification by ID.

Args: notificationId (required)

tools.name: tabz_notification_list
tools.description: List all active (undismissed) notifications.

tools.name: tabz_list_profiles
tools.description:
List terminal profiles (theme, command, working dir). Use to discover profiles before spawning.

Args: category (optional filter), response_format (optional)

category.description: Optional: Filter profiles by category name (e.g., 'AI Assistants', 'Checkpoints')

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for structured data

tools.name: tabz_list_categories
tools.description:
List all profile categories. Use to discover categories before filtering with tabz_list_profiles.

Args: response_format (optional)

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for structured data

tools.name: tabz_spawn_profile
tools.description:
Spawn a terminal using a saved profile. Use tabz_list_profiles to discover available profiles.

Args: profileId (required), workingDir (optional override), name (optional), env (optional)

profileId.description: Required: Profile ID or name to spawn (use tabz_list_profiles to discover available profiles)

workingDir.description: Optional: Override the profile's default working directory

name.description: Optional: Custom name for this terminal instance

env.description: Optional: Additional environment variables to set

tools.name: tabz_get_profile
tools.description:
Get all settings for a specific terminal profile (theme, command, working dir, etc.).

Args: profileId (required), response_format (optional)

profileId.description: Profile ID or name to retrieve

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for structured data

tools.name: tabz_create_profile
tools.description:
Create a new terminal profile for reuse when spawning terminals.

Args: name (required), command/workingDir/category/themeName/fontSize/fontFamily (optional)

name.description: Required: Display name for the profile

command.description: Optional: Command to run on terminal start (e.g., 'claude', 'npm start')

workingDir.description: Optional: Default working directory for this profile

category.description: Optional: Category to group this profile (e.g., 'AI Assistants', 'Dev Tools')

tools.name: tabz_update_profile
tools.description:
Update an existing terminal profile. Only specified fields are changed.

Args: profileId (required), updates (object with name/command/workingDir/category/themeName/fontSize/fontFamily)

tools.name: tabz_delete_profile
tools.description:
Permanently delete a terminal profile. Running terminals are unaffected.

Args: profileId (required)

tools.name: tabz_list_plugins
tools.description: List installed Claude Code plugins grouped by marketplace with enabled/disabled state. Filter by marketplace or enabled status. Use tabz_docs for detailed docs.

enabled.description: Filter by enabled status: true for enabled only, false for disabled only

tools.name: tabz_list_skills
tools.description: List available skills from enabled plugins. Filter by plugin name or search by keyword. Use tabz_get_skill to read full SKILL.md content.

search.description: Search skills by name or description (case-insensitive)

tools.name: tabz_get_skill
tools.description:
Get full details and content of a specific skill.

Reads the SKILL.md file for a skill, providing complete context
including instructions, examples, and configuration.

Args:
  - skillId (required): Skill ID in format "/pluginName:skillName"
                        (e.g., "/conductor:brainstorm", "/tabz-browser:screenshot")

Returns:
  {
    "skill": {
      "id": "/conductor:brainstorm",
      "name": "Brainstorm",
      "desc": "...",
      "pluginName": "conductor"
    },
    "content": "---\nname: Brainstorm\n...full SKILL.md content..."
  }

Examples:
  - Get skill: skillId="/conductor:brainstorm"
  - Without leading slash: skillId="conductor:brainstorm"

Use tabz_list_skills first to find available skill IDs.

tools.name: tabz_plugins_health
tools.description: Check plugin health: outdated versions, cache size, marketplace reachability. Run /restart after updating plugins.

tools.name: tabz_toggle_plugin
tools.description: Enable or disable a plugin. pluginId format: "name@marketplace". Run /restart after toggling to apply. Use tabz_docs for detailed docs.

enabled.description: Set to true to enable the plugin, false to disable

tools.name: tabz_list_terminals
tools.description: List running terminals in TabzChrome. Filter by state: 'active', 'disconnected', or 'all'. Returns IDs for tabz_send_keys and tabz_capture_terminal. Use tabz_docs for detailed docs.

response_format.description: Output format: 'markdown' for human-readable or 'json' for structured data

tools.name: tabz_send_keys
tools.description: Send text/keys to a terminal via tmux. Default 600ms delay before Enter suits Claude terminals; increase for long prompts. Use tabz_docs for detailed docs.

terminal.description: Terminal name or ID to send keys to (use tabz_list_terminals to find terminals)

text.description: Text to send to the terminal

execute.description: Whether to press Enter after sending text (default: true). Set to false to just paste text.

delay.description: Delay in milliseconds before pressing Enter (default: 600ms). Helps Claude terminals process long prompts.

tools.name: tabz_capture_terminal
tools.description: Capture recent output from a terminal's scrollback buffer. Returns last N lines (default 50, max 1000). Use tabz_docs for detailed docs.

terminal.description: Terminal name or ID to capture output from

lines.description: Number of lines to capture (default: 50, max: 1000)
